agent_discovery.description: Register a selected RGB image point into a requested 3D frame using explicitly identified camera_system_x/y/z optical coordinates, provider-aligned depth, independent channel grids, calibration, and a timestamped transform. Use this read-only Skill after a visual Skill identifies a pixel or small region.
when_to_use: A visual result must be converted from an RGB pixel into a metric 3D point.
A reflective target needs a nearby valid depth policy with explicit provenance.
RGB, IR, and depth channels may have different grids or valid boundaries.
when_not_to_use: No calibrated depth or timestamped transform is available.
A model label alone is sufficient and no metric position is required.
The request is to register a full rigid tool pose from multiple observations.
side_effects: Reads referenced RGB-D and calibration metadata.
Does not move hardware or publish a transform.

pixel_yx.description: RGB pixel as [y, x] in the source grid.
